$comment: Authentication contracts. Session is an HttpOnly cookie (luma_auth); no token is ever returned in a body. Unsafe methods require X-XSRF-TOKEN.

csrf.notes: Also sets the antiforgery cookie. The client must fetch a fresh token after login, registration and logout.

register.successSideEffect: Sets luma_auth. Public registration always creates role 'customer'; a 'role' field in the request body is ignored.

errors.400: ValidationFailed (email format, fullName >= 3, password policy, Egyptian mobile when supplied)

failureModes.401: NotAuthenticated — identical response for unknown email and wrong password
failureModes.423: LockedOut after 5 consecutive failures (Retry-After header set)

login.forbiddenBehaviour: The prototype's email-only login and 'tok_' tokens are not implemented by this API.

me.notes: Single call used by AuthContext to rehydrate the session on boot. Returns addresses and wishlist.

logout.notes: Clears luma_auth. Requires the CSRF header. The client must clear all per-user cached state (wishlist, addresses, orders) and fetch a fresh CSRF token.

guestSession.notes: Sets luma_guest (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, 30-day absolute). The cookie is the credential; guestSessionId is a non-secret identifier safe for logs. Called before checkout so a lost response cannot lose the credential. DELETE /api/v1/guest/session revokes it and clears the cookie.
